settings.heading: How to take shilajit
settings.lead: Shilajit resin is simple to take. Here is how to make it part of your day.

settings.title: Take a pea-sized amount
settings.text: Scoop a small portion of resin with a clean, dry spoon.

settings.title: Dissolve it
settings.text: Stir it into warm water, milk or tea until it has dissolved.

settings.title: Drink once a day
settings.text: Start small and keep to the amount on the label.

settings.heading: Three steps, once a day
settings.footnote: Speak to your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, taking medication or have a health condition.

settings.heading: Small habits, better results
settings.text:
Use a clean, dry spoon each time so moisture does not get into the jar. Keep the lid closed and store the jar in a cool, dry place.

Resin can harden in cold weather and soften in heat. This is normal: warm it slightly or let it rest at room temperature before scooping.

settings.question: What is shilajit?
settings.answer: Shilajit is a natural mineral resin that forms over centuries in high mountain rock, including the Himalayas. It contains fulvic acid, humic acid and trace minerals, and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries.

settings.question: How do I take shilajit?
settings.answer: Take a pea-sized amount of resin, dissolve it in warm water, milk or tea, and drink it once a day. Start small and keep to the amount on the label.

settings.question: Are there any side effects?
settings.answer: Most people tolerate shilajit well at the recommended amount. Some may notice an upset stomach. Speak to your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, taking medication or have a health condition.
